last_reply: I added a beginner-friendly guide (`app/README.md`), a `netlify.toml`, and a `.gitignore`, rebuilt `app/dist`, and verified it still loads at all three screen sizes with no sideways scroll (`rebuild_check` isn't available in this session). To publish: create a free GitHub account and repository, upload the **contents** of the `app` folder, then in Netlify choose "Add new site → Import an existing project" and select that repo — Netlify will build and give you a live link, updating automatically on future uploads. For the fastest route without GitHub, drag the `app/dist` folder onto `app.netlify.com/drop`.
